status: DRAFT_FORWARD_ONLY_NOT_ACTIVE (needs the user's explicit final confirmation; never reads validation, locked, paper or IW1 data; no DEV use)
data_state_when_written: no forward listing has been recorded yet; the collector (run/discovery/newlisting_collect.py, ADR 0061) has not run anywhere
origin: Rule D1 of STRONG_HYPOTHESES_20261102.md. The stop and size cap were designed AFTER seeing the DEV result of H_LIST (ADR 0060), so the DEV window is NOT evidence for this rule and is never re-tested with it.
hypothesis: Shorting a newly listed USDT perpetual at the open of D0+3 and holding 30 days, with a +50% fill-based stop and a per-event size cap, earns a positive per-event net return after real order-book cost, with no liquidation.
events: every USDT PERPETUAL first seen by the collector after the baseline snapshot (late_start symbols are excluded). D0 = onboardDate.
trade: SHORT at the first recorded price at or after D0+3 days 00:00 UTC (recorded 1m kline open). Exit at D0+33 days or at the first 1m kline whose high >= 1.5 x entry (exit at that stop level plus the recorded slippage to the next trade), whichever is first. Funding actually settled is added.
size: at most 0.5% of capital per event (paper accounting only; no real orders are implied by this draft)
cost: round trip from the recorded depth snapshots at the entry and exit times (walk the book for the order size). Labelled ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_DATA, not VERIFIED, until the user's real-account fills exist.
criteria_all_required: a) at least 30 forward events (about 4-5 months at 7-10 listings per month)
b) month-clustered t of the per-event net return >= 2.0
c) mean net per event > 0 and mean after stop > 3 x mean cost
d) no event with a loss larger than the stop plus 5 percentage points of slippage; worst 5% of events reported
e) result also reported at 2 x cost
stop_rule: no peeking: the analysis runs once, when criterion a) is reached; interim looks are descriptive and cannot trigger or stop anything
not_done: no activation, no window opened, no DEV re-run, no change of criteria or cost model
